description_en: Supports detection of printed mathematical formulas.
description_zh: 支持印刷体的数学公式识别
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-edu-formula --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/feaqgp/%E5%8D%B0%E5%88%B7%E4%BD%93%E6%95%B0%E5%AD%A6%E5%85%AC%E5%BC%8F%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeEduFormula

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one of them, and cannot pass through both or leave both empty.  
* Image link (URL length must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
* 本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one of them, and cannot pass through both or leave both empty.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.  
* When invoking via software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:

* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
